تستجمعون (form X)
# تَسْتَجْمِعُونَ (tastajmiʕūna) /tas.tad͡ʒ.mi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
# تُسْتَجْمَعُونَ (tustajmaʕūna) /tus.tad͡ʒ.ma.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَجْمَعَ (istajmaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
